PAYLOAD_SECRET.description: Secret key for signing JWT and cookies (generate with: node -e "console.log(require('crypto').randomBytes(48).toString('hex'))")

NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL.description: Public URL of the site (used for Paystack callbacks)

DATABASE_URI.description: SQLite connection string. Optional - app works without CMS DB

CONTACT_NOTIFY_EMAIL.description: Email address for contact form notifications

HR_NOTIFY_EMAIL.description: Email address for job application notifications
